verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs list a built-in image capability that resizes and converts images on demand and serves them from its CDN in modern formats. That matches every element of the story: resize, optimize, on-demand, and built-in CDN. The evidence is a single one-line summary, so depth is unverified. missing for 10: detailed docs on transformation parameters, caching and limits, and pricing, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN

citations.quote: Resize and convert images on demand and serve them from the CDN in modern formats.
